findings.text: Resource leak: if addStreamProperties throws after creating a stream but before returning, that stream is not added to fileDescriptors yet and cleanupCustomStreams won't destroy it. Failing input: a generator that throws during stream creation when a prior fd already created a custom stream.

Wrong behavior: pipeGroups is keyed by inputStream but should be keyed by outputStream (destination). Multiple input streams destined for the same subprocess.stdio[fdNumber] will be incorrectly grouped by their source instead of destination, causing data from different sources to be merged incorrectly or sent to wrong fds. Failing input: two transform streams both writing to stdout would be grouped separately if they have different input sources.

Unhandled edge case: fileNumber type is in FILE_TYPES but not in SPECIAL_DUPLICATE_TYPES_SYNC, so duplicate file descriptor numbers (e.g., stdout and stderr both writing to fd 3) won't trigger duplicate handling in sync mode, potentially causing data corruption from concurrent writes.
